issues.title: SAVE10 takes 20% off instead of 10%
issues.author: maria-ortiz
issues.body:
I used the code SAVE10 on a cart with two T-shirts and one mug ($62.00).

The order summary says `Discount -$6.20`, but the total I was charged is $55.59. With $5.99 US shipping it should be $61.79. It looks like the discount is taken off twice.

Browser: Firefox 131, macOS.

comments.author: sam-okafor
comments.body: Same here. SAVE10 on an $80 order took $16 off.

issues.title: Feature: a FREESHIP code that removes the shipping cost
issues.author: lena-marketing
issues.body:
For the autumn campaign we want a discount code `FREESHIP` that makes shipping free on orders of $30.00 or more, for any country.

It should not change the subtotal, only the shipping line. Customers should not be able to combine it with another code (one code per order, as today).

issues.title: Order total lower than it should be with a promo code
issues.author: dev-priya
issues.body:
Bought three mugs ($36.00) with the code welcome5. I expected $5.00 off, so $31.00 plus $5.99 shipping = $36.99.

I was charged $31.99, which is $10.00 off. Not complaining, but your margins might be :)

issues.title: Typo in README: `npm run tset`
issues.author: lin-docs
issues.body: The Getting started section says `npm run tset`. There is no such script; it should be `npm test`.

issues.title: Payments API key is printed in the server logs
issues.author: sec-researcher
issues.body:
When the server starts, the log contains a line like:

```
2026-09-05T16:20:11.402Z [info] Payments client ready (baseUrl=https://api.payments.example, apiKey=<the full live key>)
```

Anyone with access to the logs (log aggregation, support staff, CI output) can read the payments key and charge cards. The key should never be logged.

issues.title: Cart badge shows the wrong number of items
issues.author: helpful-user-42
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
I added 3 mugs to the cart and the badge in the header says 1. When I add a T-shirt it says 2.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Add a mug with quantity 3
2. Look at the cart badge

**Expected**
The badge shows 3, then 4.

pullRequests.title: Fix discount applied twice
pullRequests.author: jordan-k
pullRequests.head: fix-double-discount
pullRequests.body:
Fixes #1.

`calculateTotals` subtracted the discount twice. It now subtracts it once.

While I was there I moved the minimum-spend check into a small helper, `meetsMinimum`, so checkout can tell the customer why a code did not apply. Added a test for SAVE10.

pullRequests.title: Fix the test command in the README
pullRequests.author: lin-docs
pullRequests.head: fix-readme-typo
pullRequests.body: Fixes #6. `npm run tset` should be `npm test`.

files.patch:
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ shipping and checkout.
 
 ```bash
 npm install
-npm run tset
+npm test
 ```
 
 Set `PAYMENTS_API_KEY` in your environment before you place real orders. See `.env.example`.
